flag: --split-store-as-of <ISO-8601 UTC instant with an explicit offset, e.g. 2026-10-09T11:52:52Z>. Accepted by commonwealth_daily_valuation.py (main) and commonwealth_sweep_regrade.py (main); both take it for the round-28 repair legs (method_r28, method_r29), which are the only legs that read the split store. commonwealth_fwd3_serve.py does NOT read the store (it re-derives from the run's own security_day_price and repair sidecar), so it takes no flag and CARRIES the pin the run wrote to <data-dir>/after/split_store_pin.json into fwd3_manifest.json as split_store {address, as_of, listed, held, sha256, pinned, read_by, carried_from}; a run with no sidecar (made before this change) or a leg that does not read the store is recorded as split_store {pinned: false, read_by: none, note}. The log line is SPLIT-STORE-PIN address=<s3 prefix> as_of=<UTC> listed=<n> held=<n> sha256=<over sorted (cusip, version_id) pairs read>. The store is read through list_object_versions + get_object(VersionId); the version read for a partition is the newest splits.parquet whose LastModified is at or before the instant, a partition whose first version is later or whose current entry is a delete marker is not listed.
